Documentation.name: Web Modeling
Documentation.notes: Stereotypes, toolboxes and custom diagrams for modeling web applications.

Stereotype.name: ASP page
Stereotype.notes: A dynamically-generated web page using Microsoft's Active Server Pages (ASP) technology.

Stereotype.name: IIOP
Stereotype.notes: Internet Inter-ORB Protocol.

Stereotype.name: JSP page
Stereotype.notes: A dynamically-generated web page using Java's JavaServer Pages (JSP) technology.

Stereotype.name: RMI
Stereotype.notes: Remote Method Invocation protocol.

Stereotype.name: builds
Stereotype.notes: The relationship between a client page and the server page that builds it.

Stereotype.name: client page
Stereotype.notes: A web page that is generated by a client-side application.

Stereotype.name: clientscript object
Stereotype.notes: Client script code embedded in an HTML page.

Stereotype.name: form
Stereotype.notes: A web page that accepts user input.

Stereotype.name: frame content
Stereotype.notes: The content of a frame.

Stereotype.name: frameset
Stereotype.notes: A document that describes frame layout.

Stereotype.name: input element
Stereotype.notes: A control used by HTML forms for user input.

Stereotype.name: javascript object
Stereotype.notes: Javascript code embedded in an HTML page.

Stereotype.name: link
Stereotype.notes: Text or image on a web page that a user can click in order to access another document.

Stereotype.name: redirect
Stereotype.notes: Indicates that processing is redirected to another server page.

Stereotype.name: script library
Stereotype.notes: A collection of script code.

Stereotype.name: select element
Stereotype.notes: A control used by HTML forms for user selection.

Stereotype.name: server page
Stereotype.notes: A web page that is generated by a server-side application.

Stereotype.name: servlet
Stereotype.notes: A Java application that runs on a server and processes server-side requests.

Stereotype.name: submits
Stereotype.notes: The relationship between a form and the web page that processes it.

Stereotype.name: target
Stereotype.notes: A reference-able container for a client page.

Stereotype.name: targeted link
Stereotype.notes: An association between a client page and the target it interacts with.

Stereotype.name: text area element
Stereotype.notes: A control used by HTML forms for text entry.

Stereotype.name: web page
Stereotype.notes: A web page that has scripts executed by the server. These scripts interact with server resources.

Stereotype.name: WebModeling
Stereotype.notes: A Web Modeling diagram is an extended component diagram used for modeling the structure of a website.

Stereotype.name: WebModelingElements
Stereotype.notes: Elements used on Web Modeling diagrams

Stereotype.name: WebModelingRelationships
Stereotype.notes: Relationships used on Web Modeling diagrams

Model.description: Create a simple model of a Java Server side web application
